title: Restriction of scalars in the Cartan assertion needs a dimensional convention
quote: les Cartans de $\underline{g}$ considérée comme algèbre sur $k$ sont les mêmes
context: Differs from CT16/026's shrinking-base Cartan extension (CT L1091); the searched CT/CN supply no restriction-of-scalars theorem for these Lie algebras.
ledger: WG2 §1.1 #3 [unchecked organizational plan; no topical settled result ID]
body: The addition quantifies over a subfield k of K and asserts equality of the Cartan subalgebras when the same Lie algebra is viewed over either field. If K/k is infinite, finite dimensionality over K does not imply finite dimensionality over k, so the permitted category and definition of Cartan must be explicit. The sheet gives no finite-extension restriction and no proof of this scalar-change assertion.
